settings.title: We're here for you. In a way.
settings.rich_text:
Sometimes, dad-ing is so hard you need backup. We get it. You might be looking for advice, validation, or just someone to confirm that yes, covering your child in duct tape was probably not the best idea. We’ll try to help… but let’s be honest—we’re just dads too. We don’t have degrees in child psychology, but we do have strong opinions and a decent meme game.

For some questionable wisdom, behind-the-scenes chaos, and the occasional parenting win, stalk us here:

📸 Instagram

📘 Facebook

If you’re reaching out for any other reason—feedback, partnership ideas, dad rants, or emotional support—shoot us an email at info@bestdadbook.com or just fill out the neat little form below.

We read everything. Eventually. Probably while hiding from our kids in the bathroom.
